import json, hashlib, subprocess, datetime
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

rng=np.random.default_rng(319481)
projection_errors=[]; identity_errors=[]; bound_slacks=[]; repeat_errors=[]
for case in range(48):
    A=rng.normal(size=(11,4)); y=rng.normal(size=11); e=rng.normal(size=11)
    X=A[:,:2]; Z=np.column_stack([A[:,2:],A[:,2]])
    M=np.eye(11)-Z@np.linalg.pinv(Z); S=X.T@M@X
    joint=np.column_stack([X,Z])
    p=np.linalg.lstsq(joint,y,rcond=None)[0][:2]
    ph=np.linalg.lstsq(joint,y-e,rcond=None)[0][:2]
    projection_errors.append(float(np.linalg.norm(ph-p+np.linalg.solve(S,X.T@M@e))))
    P=A.T@A; w,V=np.linalg.eigh(P); root=(V*np.sqrt(w))@V.T; ir=(V/np.sqrt(w))@V.T
    D=rng.normal(size=A.shape); D*=.7/np.linalg.norm(D@ir,2); B=A+D
    b=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]; bh=np.linalg.lstsq(B,y-e,rcond=None)[0]
    r=A@b-y; d=D@b+e; dg=A.T@d+D.T@r+D.T@d
    identity_errors.append(float(np.linalg.norm(bh-b+np.linalg.solve(B.T@B,dg))))
    eps=np.linalg.norm(D@ir,2); ev=np.linalg.eigvalsh(ir@B.T@B@ir)
    j=rng.normal(size=4); v=j@np.linalg.solve(P,j); vh=j@np.linalg.solve(B.T@B,j)
    bound=np.linalg.norm(ir@dg)/(1-eps)**2
    bound_slacks.extend(map(float,[ev.min()-(1-eps)**2,(1+eps)**2-ev.max(),vh-v/(1+eps)**2,v/(1-eps)**2-vh,bound-np.linalg.norm(root@(bh-b)),np.sqrt(v)*bound-abs(j@(bh-b))]))
    predicted=-np.linalg.solve(P,A.T@e)
    for n in (1,3,17):
        # Fresh, arbitrary block responses and a shared nonzero additive defect.
        ys=rng.normal(size=(n,11)) + np.arange(n)[:,None]*.13
        An=np.tile(A,(n,1)); yn=ys.ravel(); en=np.tile(e,n)
        bn=np.linalg.lstsq(An,yn,rcond=None)[0]; bhn=np.linalg.lstsq(An,yn-en,rcond=None)[0]
        repeat_errors.append(float(np.linalg.norm(bhn-bn-predicted)))
        assert np.allclose(np.linalg.inv(An.T@An),np.linalg.inv(P)/n,rtol=1e-11,atol=1e-12)
assert max(projection_errors+identity_errors+repeat_errors)<1e-11
assert min(bound_slacks)>-1e-11
prior=[]; design=[]
for n in (1,2):
    A=np.ones((n+1,1)); y=np.zeros(n+1); e=np.r_[np.ones(n),0.]
    prior.append(float((np.linalg.lstsq(A,y-e,rcond=None)[0]-np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0])[0]))
for ys in ([1.],[1.,3.]):
    A=np.ones((len(ys),1)); y=np.array(ys)
    design.append(float((np.linalg.lstsq(1.5*A,y,rcond=None)[0]-np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0])[0]))
assert np.allclose(prior,[-.5,-2/3]) and np.allclose(design,[-1/3,-2/3])
